basf.title: Digitalization Intern, Asia-Pacific Monomers
bullets: Identified a critical intelligence gap in BASF's MDI/TDI pricing process: marketing analysts were manually monitoring 3--4 news sources across two languages to track demand signals — an error-prone process feeding VP-level pricing decisions in a market where BASF holds significant pricing authority in China.

Designed and deployed an \textbf{end-to-end LLM-powered (GPT-4o) market intelligence engine} that automated bilingual news monitoring, extraction, and synthesis — replacing the manual workflow entirely and delivering structured weekly and monthly insight reports directly consumed by pricing decision-makers.
Partnered with marketing stakeholders to ensure output format matched executive reporting requirements, driving adoption from day one and eliminating the need for manual news triage across the team.

Supported \textbf{8+ additional digitalization initiatives} across supply chain, EHS, and production — including Power BI dashboard redesigns and data pipeline automation — serving as the technical translator between business requirements and deployed solutions.

thesis_uplift.title: Thesis: Decision-Focused Uplift Modeling for AUUC Maximization
bullets: Proposed a \textbf{DFL framework} optimizing marketing ROI directly via composite loss, formulated as Integer Linear Programming (ILP) — \textbf{outperforming Causal Forest by 2\% AUUC} on large-scale datasets, demonstrating superior stability in individual treatment effect estimation.
